Hamburger Buns Baker's Percentage

Palm-wide disks, roughly 90 to 100 g each, pressed slightly flat before the last proof so they do not dome into balls.

Detailed method

The calculator opens at 500 g flour, 62% hydration, 2% salt, and 1.1% yeast. The balls fields open at 9 buns of about 92 g each. Brush them with 1 beaten egg and top them with about 15 g of sesame. The egg and the sesame are extra and are not in the gram total. These times assume you only change the flour amount and keep the percentages the same. Still judge the dough by how it looks and feels.

  1. Mix Stir the flour, water, salt, and yeast, then knead for about 8 minutes until smooth. At 62% it is soft. Aim for about 24°C (75°F).
  2. Bulk Cover the bowl at about 24°C (75°F) for 60 to 90 minutes. With 1.1% yeast it should nearly double.
  3. Divide Cut nine pieces of about 92 g. Round each one and rest them, covered, for 10 minutes.
  4. Flatten Press each ball into a disk about 10 cm across. If you leave them as balls they bake into domes, not buns.
  5. Proof Set them on a tray with space between them. Cover them at about 24°C (75°F) for 30 to 45 minutes, until puffy.
  6. Top Brush with 1 beaten egg and sprinkle about 15 g of sesame. The egg and the sesame are extra and are not in the gram total.
  7. Bake Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F). Bake 14 to 16 minutes, until the tops are golden and the sides are set.
  8. Cool Move them to a rack for at least 20 minutes before you split them.
